title: refactor(layout)!: retire the navigation-renderer and responsive-grid node type keys; navigation is app metadata, the breakpoint grid is grid (objectui#11441)
body:
Fixes #11441

Clause-②: yes

Part of #10859: this card runs as one more batch of that family, on the same ratchet. It executes the maintainer's ruling on objectui#11441, record `5950208338` (batch 268 item 5, letters B / B, 「同意」), under the seat's claim `5950898710`. Dispatched dev of `domain:ui` seat 1, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37`.

## What changes

- **`packages/layout/src/index.ts`**: the `responsive-grid` and `navigation-renderer` registrations (each with its `layout:` twin) become tombstone docblocks. They describe the retired calls and do not quote them, because the registration readers take a quoted call in a comment for a live one. The two imports that only fed the registrations go; `export *` keeps both components public.
- **The components stay exported.** `NavigationRenderer` is what app-shell's `UnifiedSidebar` and this package's `AppSchemaRenderer` mount. `ResponsiveGrid` had no in-repo consumer except the retired registration, so it is now a React-only export. It stays because the ruling keeps objectui#7580's vocabulary half: `BreakpointColumnMap` stays declared in `ResponsiveGrid.tsx`, unchanged, as the type of its `columns` prop. ⛔ `BreakpointColumnMap` is not removed.
- **`known-schema-types.ts`** is regenerated by `node scripts/regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs`. Four entries leave: `navigation-renderer`, `responsive-grid`, `layout:navigation-renderer`, `layout:responsive-grid`.
- **The ratchet** (`registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts`): `REFUSED_AT_TYPE` 20 → 18 and `NAMESPACED_REFUSED_AT_TYPE` 374 → 372. Both namespaced twins were refused at `type` on both faces (measured), so the namespaced pin moves by 2. A new `UNREGISTERED_11441` map and its row; `STILL_REFUSED_10859` loses both keys and its set-equality row holds; the docblock's projection now reads 8 after phase 2d and 0 after objectui#11440.
- **Pins whose subject left.** `navigation-renderer-items-declaration.test.tsx` is deleted: its objectui#3972 / objectui#3987 rows read the declaration that is gone. `navigation-responsive-grid-retired-11441.test.tsx` replaces it: the source read and the live registry both lack every spelling (lit control `app-schema-renderer`, both spellings), a node of either key renders the OBJUI-001 panel (render control `layout:page:card`), `NavigationRenderer` is still exported, and `ResponsiveGrid` still resolves a breakpoint map. In the schema-catalog file, the objectui#3972 / objectui#3987 manifest describes go, a retirement pin replaces them (lit control `grid`), and the objectui#3900 containment control moves to `app-schema-renderer`.
- **Lit controls that used `responsive-grid` move**: `app-shell-not-a-component-key` to `layout:page:card`; `page-header-authorable-keys` and the side-effects bundle probe to `app-schema-renderer`; the layout containment census to its two remaining registrations. The sidebar-nav doc pin learns the number word `two`. Scope notes that said `navigation-renderer` takes an icon name now say `NavigationRenderer`, the component that still does.
- **Teaching.** `content/docs/guide/layout.md`: the registered-key sentence (two keys) and the paragraph on a navigation tree that must come from JSON, which now points at the app document's `navigation` items drawn by the shell. The layout README, the docs-site registrar docblock, and the `@object-ui/types` comments (`mobile.ts`, `complex.ts`, `index.ts`, two test comments) that named the `responsive-grid` registration as the ground for the re-homed breakpoint vocabulary: they now name `grid`'s breakpoint `columns`, keyed by `BreakpointName`, and `ResponsiveGrid`'s prop.
- **Changesets.** `@object-ui/layout` minor and `@object-ui/cli` minor, each with the BREAKING (authoring) banner and migration lines. Dated notes on the three pending entries that named either key as live: `10859-retire-page-header-layout`, `7580-responsive-vocabulary-rehome` (the ruling updates its item 2), `9910-children-slot-declare-and-pin`; frontmatter md5 unchanged on all three. No console entry: `apps/console` has no stub for either key (grep 0). `@object-ui/types` changed comments only and carries no entry.

## Premise gate, re-measured

- objectui at `ad1785c1d` (main with phase 2c): outside CHANGELOGs, every hit for either key is the registration, the generated list, a test, a comment or prose. 0 producers in non-test source, `examples/**`, the catalog, `content/docs` and `skills/**`; 0 runtime emission.
- objectstack `origin/main` `3b4efa74`: `git grep -E "navigation-renderer|responsive-grid"` exit 1 (0 hits). Control in the same command shape: `page-header` answers 23 files. The `NavigationRenderer` / `ResponsiveGrid` hits there name the React components in prose.
- One teaching site the card's "0 teaching sites" did not count: the layout guide advised "`navigation-renderer` when the tree has to come from metadata" (prose, no node authored). It is corrected here to the ruling's home for navigation. Not a producer, so no fork.

## Migration lines, measured on both faces

`safeValidateSchema` (tolerant, what `objectui validate` runs) and `StrictAnyComponentSchema` (strict), at this head:

| document | tolerant | strict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `responsive-grid` with `columns: { xs: 1, md: 2 }`, and `layout:responsive-grid` | refused at `type` | refused at `type` |
| `navigation-renderer` with `items: []`, and `layout:navigation-renderer` | refused at `type` | refused at `type` |
| `grid` with `columns: { xs: 1, md: 2 }`, `gap: 4` and one child | pass | pass |
| `grid` with `columns: { xs: 1, xxl: 6 }` (control) | `unrecognized_keys` at `columns` (`xxl`) | same |
| `app` with `name` and a one-entry `navigation` array | pass | pass |
| `app` with `navigation` as an object (control) | `invalid_type` at `navigation` | same |
| `app` with `name`, `basePath` and `navigation: []` | pass | `unrecognized_keys` (`basePath`) |
| `app-schema-renderer` with a `schema` object | refused at `type` (objectui#11440 arms it) | same |

Through the real `SchemaRenderer` (a temporary probe, deleted): `grid` with `{ xs: 1, md: 2 }` and `gap: 4` renders `grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4` and draws its child; `responsive-grid` renders the OBJUI-001 panel, which the new test now pins. So the layout changeset names `grid` with `columns` / `gap`, and the app document's `navigation`; it says the strict face refuses `basePath` on the app document as an unrecognized key; and it does not recommend the `app-schema-renderer` node, which `objectui validate` refuses at `type` today.

A second run over the source-reading pins (`node-slot-registered-arms-8499`, both container-declaration census / ratchet files, `check-prompt-component-keys`, `check-sdui-registration-pins.test`, `registry-assertion-ratchet-8316`, three `@object-ui/types` files naming `app-schema-renderer`, `grid-breakpoint-columns-7097`): `Test Files 10 passed (10)`, `Tests 925 passed (925)`.

- **Gates, exit 0**: `check:doc-types` (887 registered + 290 exempted of 1177 sites), `check:doc-snippets` (after its `--build-filter` turbo build, 35/35 tasks), `check:doc-examples`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:doc-fences`, `regenerate-catalog-index.py --check`, `regenerate-known-schema-types.mjs --check`, `check:registry-bare-names`, `markdown-test-inputs.mjs --audit`, `check-doc-links.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs` (17 source files of 3 released packages, 2 changesets), `check:changeset-claims` (report-only; the 23 pending entries it lists were read, none falsified), `changeset:check`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:prompt-keys`, `check:installed-pin-claims`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:component-surface-parity`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:readme-exports`, `check:skills-paths`, and `check:sdui-registration-pins` after a console build (14 of 14 derived registrations present; the two retired keys left the derived set).
- **ESLint, narrowed**: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 20 changed ts/tsx files that exist, each compared with its base blob through `--stdin`: per-file error and warning counts equal the base in every file (2 pre-existing `no-restricted-imports` errors in `@object-ui/types`, visible only without inline config, identical at base). Population: the root `eslint.config.js` is the only config, read by the package `lint` scripts (`eslint .`; cli `eslint src`). It sets no `projectService` or `parserOptions.project`, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. Full `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- Governed check: `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 28 paths answers NOT GOVERNED. Control-byte self-scan over the 27 changed files: 0 hits.

## Reverse verification and ablation, predicted first

- **Base leg**: `packages/layout/src/index.ts` and `known-schema-types.ts` checked out at `ad1785c1d`, new tests kept. Predicted 11 red: 4 ratchet rows, 4 in the new layout file, 2 in the schema-catalog retirement pin, 1 in the sidebar-nav doc pin. Got `Tests 11 failed | 128 passed (139)`, exactly those, including "refuses 20 registered bare key(s) at `type`; the pin is 18" and "refuses 374 registered namespaced key(s) at `type`; the pin is 372". Restored by a trap: both blobs equal HEAD, `git diff HEAD` 0 lines.
- **Ablation** through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode), restoring ONE registration, `responsive-grid`, with its import: anchor 1 → 0, blob `e4f4ea8ea800` → `90f86f86b05b`, and the on-disk count of the register call is 1. Leg 1 (source only), predicted: `derivation-5115` red plus 5 rows. Got 7 failed: the two derivation rows ("omits no registered type", "matches … byte for byte"), three in the new layout file, the schema-catalog `responsive-grid` row and the sidebar-nav doc row. Leg 2 (list regenerated under the ablation), predicted 9: got 9, with "refuses 19 … the pin is 18" naming `responsive-grid` and "refuses 373 … the pin is 372", the 11441 row and the set-equality row, plus the same five; `derivation-5115` green. Restored: the tool proved `index.ts` blob equals HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty, and my trap proved the regenerated list's blob equals HEAD.

## Acceptance notes (out of scope, not filed)

- `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` (governed) still says `BreakpointColumnMap` in `@object-ui/layout` (`responsive-grid`) spells the same six. The claim about six keys stays true; the parenthetical now names a retired key. Editing it would make this PR governed, so it is left for a separate governed one-line change, named in the dev report.
- `scripts/__tests__/component-registrations.test.ts` keeps `responsive-grid` and `page-header` as synthetic fixture strings for the registration reader. They are not registry claims, and phase 2c left `page-header` the same way.

## Serial

- objectui#10859 phase 2d edits the same ratchet test. Whichever lands second merges `main` and re-pins; with its ten `sidebar-*` retirements on top of this the bare pin goes 18 → 8.
- `main` moved to `4a1adb76e` (objectui#11456, i18n) after this branch merged `ad1785c1d`. No file overlaps this diff, and the queue rebuilds on current `main`.
